title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
snippet: nthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.

title: Google Built an AI That Hunts Its Own Security Bugs
snippet: Google's PageBreak agent autonomously finds and verifies real vulnerabilities in its own web apps, cutting through the flood of noisy AI-generated security reports.

title: Want to get off gas? Learn how at Drive Electric Month events across the US
snippet: Drive Electric Month continues this week with over 150 online and in-person events celebrating electric vehicles through most of September and the start of October. Events will be held for the next few weekends, with events in most US states, and one in Canada. And in the midst of a global oil price spike with US prices at record highs, there couldn’t be a better time to learn how to become energy independent.
